mentions.name: Combined workout + calorie tracker app
mentions.description: This app combines workout tracking and calorie tracking into a single app, aiming to make logging as seamless as possible with minimal tapping or thinking. It is currently being built for personal use, with a possible public release if others have the same need.
mentions.problem: Existing workout and calorie tracker apps are poorly integrated and require too much tapping and thinking to track what the user wants.
mentions.audience: Currently built for personal use; the author is gauging whether others share the same struggle before considering a public release.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a workout + calorie tracker combined into in 1 app. This is a crowded market already, yet somehow all the workout/calorie tracker apps I used never fit my lifestyle.

evidence.value: I'm working on a workout + calorie tracker combined into in 1 app. This is a crowded market already, yet somehow all the workout/calorie tracker apps I used never fit my lifestyle.
